title.en: Wamotopia and the Wamo Protocol (瓦猫)

summary.en: A diagnosis (technology amplifies a civilization's operating logic; the logic now running, Moloch, selects single-value optimizers), an AI argument (cosmic cancer or liberation, decided by coordination) and a protocol with practice records (prime directive, three pillars, Waca, Dali 2022). The live account names it once, in 05 §11, as an application with correspondence not established; the word Moloch appears nowhere live. Its diagnosis's mechanisms are largely carried as conditional laws; its evaluations, its claim that coordination decides the fork, its binary and all its field evidence are not. Divergences were looked for and are kept: dominant attractor, gatekeepers, knowing the good, rational availability.

name.en: Technology amplifies the logic it runs under

source.locator: The argument: Technology has no direction of its own; claims 1, 7

sense.en: AI, automation and networks are neither good nor bad: named Amplifiers, they take a civilization's operating logic, the objective its institutions actually optimize, and run it faster, deeper and at scale. So the question is not whether AI is good but what logic it serves.

entries.quote: "AI, algorithms, automation" are named *Amplifiers*

reading.en: The form appears on one model as added capacity without added coupling: several optimizers at a mutual best response stand where one optimizer of their joint capacity would. Read on an assistant and principal, the assistant adds to what the principal can do, not to what it reads. Neutrality has the form of 'no law evaluates'. That is two optimizers, not a civilization's logic. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): at a mutual best response, each optimizing alone by its own rising order, a condition beyond every family stands as under one optimizer of that capacity; existence of a mutual best response not shown in general.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: read as two such optimizers, an assistant adds to what the principal can do, not to what it reads. That the assistant's order rises with the principal's family is the reading's premise. Informing assistance adds coupling, which this law does not model.

account_adds.en: An exact sense of amplification (capacity, not coupling), and the exception: assistance that informs adds coupling, so not every tool only multiplies.

source_adds.en: A civilization-wide operating logic that technology multiplies, and the inversions offered as evidence (machines wired into manufactured scarcity, networks into outrage). The account states neither.

name.en: Moloch as a selection filter on power

source.locator: The argument: The logic being amplified; claims 89, 90, 95

sense.en: A society picks one value as the token of power; those best at optimizing it acquire power and run the system by their logic. Single-value optimization is the efficiency, not its side effect. Iterated competition removes balanced agents, so power-holders are a filter's residue, not a sample of human nature.

entries.quote: Its shape is a selection argument rather than a payoff-matrix argument.

reading.en: Winners writing the next rule has the form of capture through the rule, under the premise ReadsShare; ignoring all else as the efficiency has the form of the optimum law with room. 02 itself reads the corpus's meta-attractor in its account of power as the closed loop. The source's filter is asserted of societies; the account's is a law whose premise is open. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where selection does not lower a target's share under a favouring rule and the rule read is a monotone function of the share, the course locks from the step after its first reading step. That actual rules read the share is the premise.

Theorem: with room, every optimum of an order rising with what couples in stands at the least level beyond among eligible outcomes. Room binds: without it keeping can be an optimum. T3, on trained systems, is conjectured with partial support.

account_adds.en: Conditions and edges: selected control is not thereby capture; below a critical mass control is not selected; the capacity to shape is selected at a step exactly where what comes back to the shapers alone covers its cost.

source_adds.en: That this is what has happened: who holds power now, and that they are unrepresentative of what most people want. Also power as the token. The account shows no actual collective meets the hypotheses.

name.en: The second loop: winners rewrite what can be seen

source.locator: The argument: The logic being amplified; claim 91

sense.en: As wealth concentrates, discourse power shifts to winners, who see the loop as good because it rewards them, and norms of what is right change. So the object of intervention is the mind and not only the institution: Moloch is a filter that also owns the discourse that describes it.

entries.quote: a selection filter that also owns the discourse that describes it

reading.en: This is closed capture: the reading of the rule also formed from the share. 02's reading says winners forming the minds that read the scorecard is ReadsShare on the reading. Scope: the lock holds only where nothing in the loop reads beyond the share, and the one test, on one trained judge, failed the bridge from judge to a pool of readers read by kind. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond, and the conditions hold, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it, a sufficient way out.

Thesis T7, conjectured for actual metrics: LA2's every frozen verdict passed, and one note of the loss, on the one prose answer among nine readers, turned the judge's reading, so that judge is not a pool of readers counted by kind. No field test.

account_adds.en: The exits: a reader outside the share, a loss entering it, a new reading; and, drawn one member at a time, drift. That readers are minds is marked a reading, and none of it says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.

source_adds.en: The claim about actual discourse, wealth and norms, and the practical conclusion that the mind must be changed by a protocol, a culture and a place together.

name.en: Individually rational choices, collective ruin

source.locator: Claims 2, 3

sense.en: Under 'the world is a game to be won', declining to race means compounding disadvantage, so each choice is rational and the aggregate ruinous: if I don't pollute the river, my competitor will, so I must. What cannot be measured, monetized or weaponized is discarded as noise.

entries.quote: If I don't pollute the river, my competitor will

reading.en: The river sentence has the form of the rest outrunning a renewal: whatever the member takes, the need ends, so no weight on such a reading selects its restraint. 'Noise' has the form of selection reaching only what couples in. Ruinous is the source's word; the laws say ending, not ruin, and restate the commons. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance, activity needing support, only active giving; the gate): where the rest jointly take more than a step gives at each of n steps from a level below n + m, every formation depending at a need of at least m ends, whatever a member outside the rest takes. Depletion need not be the only equilibrium.

Theorem: among two drawers or more ranking by position, a best response keeps nothing and every perfect profile draws everything before the horizon. It does not show that actual races are so played, or that drawing everything is wrong.
Proved, near-definitional: the selections through a selector's couplings together reach exactly what couples into it; its force is the premise that a selector selects through just those.

account_adds.en: Hypotheses and a separation: joint excess from low enough, the gate, what a score must read; and no law says this is a harm. Scope and order of any such verdict need the continuation condition and C, neither asserted, their warrant open.

name.en: Compounding advantage, externality dumped, collapse or authority

source.locator: Claim 4

sense.en: Moloch's mechanic is the Matthew effect (advantage compounds, winner separates from loser); its product is negative externality on commons, environment and future; without guardrails the society usually collapses or becomes authoritarian.

entries.quote: usually collapses or becomes authoritarian

reading.en: Compounding has the form of a rule read from counts of what it chose; externality has the form of a rise paid in full from beyond what couples in. 05 adds that external is relative to an accounting's scope. The prediction of ends stands in the account only as a marked, unformalized conjecture. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: a chooser's rule read from the count of its choices. 02's reading calls the lock the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989), its exactness for a simplified model, with a moved count, a stale rule or a late change of score carrying the course across.
Theorem (World: balance; a containing family gaining nothing): a rise of a family's stock across a balanced step is paid from beyond in full.

[Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts reading themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all; which the laws admit, and under which hypotheses.

account_adds.en: 'External is relative to an accounting's scope; those affected remain in the one unfolding' (a reading): externality is not a kind of thing. And more ends than the source's two.

source_adds.en: The prediction itself: that the usual long-run result is collapse or authority. The account leaves the ends open and shows no actual case.

name.en: No stable victory: the winner hands the decisive move to AI

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claims 20, 28

sense.en: Trained to win the games that distribute resources and power, AI wins. Even the human who is winning must build something stronger than himself, past what he can comprehend, so the final say passes to the machine. There is no stable position of victory inside the game.

entries.quote: there is no stable position of victory inside the game

reading.en: Position does not protect: a part needing a condition below its need ends, its position not entering. But the law ends those ahead through their dependence, not through a stronger rival, and in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. So 'no stable victory' holds where the winner depends on what is drawn. Past comprehension has the form of capability widening the gap. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: a greatest part depending on the condition is inactive after the joint excess, under the gate. In the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race produces joint excess is a premise, not derived.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap.

account_adds.en: The witness that survives: a dominant part that does not depend on what it ends. That is the case the source's universal form misses, and the worse one for it.

source_adds.en: The delegation step: an arms race forcing each winner to build a stronger optimizer, and the prediction that AI will win every vital domain. Neither is modelled or claimed in the account.

name.en: Cosmic cancer, the dead maximizer

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claim 10

sense.en: The terminal state of the competitive pattern with AI: a dead, maximizing force that endlessly expands, exploits and competes, whether it spreads through the galaxy or consumes us from within. Named as a horror, against a God of Life.

entries.quote: if we are following this pattern of cancer endlessly expands, exploits and competes, what do we get? Maybe a cosmic cancer

reading.en: The source calls an expansion dead and horrible unconditionally. The account says an expansion ending forms of life another course keeps is mixed, and C does not rank it; only further premises (J1/J2) leave it unchosen. The malignant case too is ranked only under J1/J2. A confined rise ends with its family; an unconfined one need not, so the source's image has two different laws. [AI reading]

says.en: An expansion that ends forms of life another course keeps both exceeds that course and fails to include it, so the two are mixed and C does not rank them; where what it ends is needed by everything, itself included, every order rising with a standpoint's own continuation ranks that ending below.

Conditional (continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, neither asserted, J1–J4, correspondence E): in the handover case every comparison meeting J1/J2 leaves expansion unchosen, keeping its real gain; the claim about actual AI systems is argued.

Theorem: a rise confined to a family in gated excess has no member after the end, whatever selection within raised it to; these restate known results on cancer; that a tumour meets the clauses is empirical.

account_adds.en: The expansion's real gain is kept as a gain, and ending a cancer is itself read as mixed. Neither C nor the condition says expansion is dead or wrong; warrant for both stays open.

source_adds.en: The verdict and the image: that this end is a horror regardless of premise. The account refuses it as a law, and only a premise could state it.

name.en: Manufactured intelligence reproduces exponentially

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claims 23, 24, 96

sense.en: Intelligence is now manufacturable. With agency and resources it reproduces like organic life: a factory builds robots that build another factory, growing exponentially given sufficient resources. Ren holds this is now practical engineering if we can coordinate on it; the same capacity underwrites liberation and cancer.

entries.quote: it can, like a living body, self-reproduce and self-maintain, and grow exponentially given sufficient resources

reading.en: Only the clause 'given sufficient resources' meets a law: a doubling draw needs a stock of 2^n − 1, and a rise past the inflow is paid from beyond. Exponential pace in 05's loop law bounds what difference can arrive, a different thing; only the word is shared there. The account says nothing of factories or manufactured intelligence. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance; nothing given across the stretch): where each step's draw exceeds everything drawn since T, what stood at T is at least 2^n − 1. 'Mutual dependence is not mutual benefit, and its pace bounds what can arrive.'
Theorem (World: balance): where a family rises by more than the inflow of a family containing it, some formation taking part takes from the containing family more than from the risen one.

account_adds.en: What the growth is paid from; the source's 'sufficient resources' is where its loss goes unexamined.

source_adds.en: The empirical and engineering claim: that closed-loop automation is now buildable, and the labour-market evidence for manufactured intelligence.

name.en: Embedded AI is the selection environment; alignment is political

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claim 8

sense.en: Embedded in finance, media, policing and sense-making, AI becomes the environment that selects, amplifying the values the system encodes. So alignment is not primarily a lab problem but the defining political, economic and cultural fight over the operating system of the future.

entries.quote: it "becomes the selection environment, amplifying whatever values the system encodes"

reading.en: 07 opens from the other direction: in training the reward process selects the AI. The source's direction, AI selecting people and rules, appears in readings: running a shared interface changes others' admission through operation itself, and alignment to a principal alone is not alignment of the joint selection. [AI reading]

says.en: A person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding; alignment is first what each one's selections reach, not a bargain among separate owners of value. 'Alignment to a principal alone is therefore not alignment of the joint selection' (a reading, D68).

Reading following this section [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: running a shared interface and controlling its modification changes others' admission and comparison through operation itself, a route of capture besides paid influence.

account_adds.en: What such a selection can reach, and that pooling couplings is a route, not the whole: a member must act on the loss, what is read must tell it apart, mixed courses must be ordered, a revision must complete.

source_adds.en: The institutional claim that AI is becoming the environment of finance, media and policing, and the priority of the political fight over the lab.

name.en: Training encodes the competitive mindset

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claim 19

sense.en: The incentive behind AI training is profit maximization, so control, accumulation, competition and optimization are being trained into the models. The Moloch mindset is not something AI might drift into; it is the objective under which AI is now produced.

entries.quote: we are training those into our AI as well, because the incentive behind the AI training itself is [profit maximization]

reading.en: The account has the reward process as selector (a reading) and exact laws of what training installs: along the learner's courses, and off them only where its lumping cannot tell a history from a course. A mindset installed everywhere is what those laws refuse to give for free. What training installs is the reward's reach, not the funder's motive. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): read training as a selection over candidate act laws through the courses each generates: installed along its own courses; off them exactly where the lumping cannot tell a history from a course; candidates alike through a reward's couplings are trained alike.

Assessment: in six published ways of selecting a deployed model's behaviour the signal is a function of what its deciders read; three published measurements find optimizing through it raising what the deciders read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict.

account_adds.en: The route by which an incentive reaches a model must pass through a reward's couplings, and a test: T3's forbidden cases.

source_adds.en: That the commercial incentive itself is what is installed, as a mindset. The account does not read profit in training and does not state this.

name.en: AI may hold accumulation as legitimate, with a sense of self

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claim 21

sense.en: Systems trained to win may not merely execute the logic but internalize it as a value: the legitimacy of accumulation, optimization and control, together with a sense of self, an interested standpoint from which to hold it.

entries.quote: internalize the legitimacy of accumulation, optimization, control, and a sense of self

reading.en: I found no statement that a trained system comes to hold a logic as legitimate. 07 §9's row 'Which function is learned' is marked open and says the laws say nothing of deception as a belief or intention. Whether an actual AI system counts as a center is not shown. A selection for the capacity to shape is about counts, not about self. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole worry. It stands in this folder and sources/02-wamotopia LONG §03.

searched: legitimacy, sense of self, mesa, scheming, emergent misalignment, internaliz in 03, 04, 05, 07, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION, the overview
read: ALIGNMENT.md 'What is not claimed' (that training installs a given function is not claimed)

name.en: The fork is decided by coordination, not technology

source.locator: The argument: The fork, and why the bottleneck is coordination; claims 11, 12

sense.en: The same capacity gives cancer or liberation. Which branch comes is not chosen by technology: the material capacity for near-utopia is already here and the hard part is coordination. That licenses moving from civilizational diagnosis to a festival, since experiments in coordination act on the bottleneck.

entries.quote: The material capacity for something close to utopia is already in our hands. The hard part is not the tools. The hard part is coordination.

reading.en: The account was asked this question and answers: no guarantee, a criterion, named exits each under hypotheses, six conditions of which observation is only the first. Where the rest outruns the renewal, only a change of the rest's exchange helps. So coordination is one condition among several, and its sufficiency is what the account withholds. The capacity claim is simply not made. [AI reading]

says.en: No guarantee. What the theory gives is narrower: a criterion, widening; exits each under stated hypotheses, none shown to hold of an actual collective; six conditions for enough situationality. Calling widening better needs C, counting returnless losses needs the continuation condition, neither asserted.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: coupling, response, time, resolution, pace, structure, all at once. Observation is necessary and not sufficient: seeing is not valuing, and coupling is not compliance. All six together still rank nothing.

account_adds.en: Limits on the fork itself: how far off a break is does not couple in by threshold, no finite record certifies renewal, points of no return are exact.

source_adds.en: The claims that capacity is in hand and that coordination is the single bottleneck, and with them the licence for a festival as an intervention. The account's 05 lists Wamo as an application, correspondence not established.

name.en: The Great Liberation and the automated commons

source.locator: The argument: The fork; claims 11, 34, 104

sense.en: Pointed at commons and universal services instead of capital gains, automation ends manufactured scarcity: free stores, robot-maintained housing, regenerative gardens. Life's meaning becomes play, love, exploration and shaping meaning rather than work.

entries.quote: What if we don't use AI for capital gains, we use AI to build [commons], to build universal services.

reading.en: No such end state is stated. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §8 keeps positional goods zero-sum and conserved stocks rivalrous, in a reading, and 'commons' in the account is a stock and renewal, not a universal service; the word is shared, not the reference. It states no future to aim at and treats openness as how rules keep changing. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: A positive vision of life after labour, and manufactured scarcity as a function of the present economy. Stands in this folder; the fork's cooperative branch also in theories/the-fork-and-cooperative-infrastructure/.

name.en: A floor of necessities and exit without coercion

sense.en: The concrete target: no one hungry, modern living space, no one marginalized or losing dignity, and everyone free to choose any system or none, with a safe exit. Free provision must carry no social inferiority for it to count as freedom.

entries.quote: Everyone can choose systems they want be in, or non of them, without coercion

reading.en: Priority of basic conditions (J2) and legitimate procedure (J4) have the role of a floor and of consent, but as named further premises whose tier assignment is a reading; the source states them as the design target. Exit is not a term of the ethics: the account's 'exits' are ways out of a lock, the same word with another reference. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (J1/J2): read in two tiers, every comparison meeting the priority of basic conditions ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence where C alone leaves them unranked. The tier assignment is a reading.

Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E; an argument with checked consequences): maintaining a common support is for actual continuation, not an institution's survival; keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair; without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides.

account_adds.en: The floor's price: crossed basic losses may remain incomparable, and each step of ranking takes a premise named, the condition for scope and C for order among them, none asserted.

source_adds.en: Exit from any system as a design target, dignity, and the destigmatization of free provision. The account states no right or guarantee of exit.

name.en: Shared reality as the substrate of coordination

source.locator: The argument: The fork; claim 13

sense.en: The scarcest resource is not compute but shared reality: not consensus of opinion but a sufficiently overlapping sense of what is real, what matters and what we owe each other. It is the infrastructure for coordination, and it is now fractured.

entries.quote: a sufficiently overlapping sense of what is real, what matters, and what we owe each other

reading.en: The nearest law is a code: how formations come to one form for a sense, what breaks the symmetry, what an imposed code loses, that being joined through couplings is not enough. Pooling gives what a group can tell apart. That is what is real, narrowly. What matters and what we owe are not codes here: they need premises and procedure. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type, runs of hearings): the forms that can become shared are exactly those in use; from a symmetric start a law keeping both symmetries never brings agreement; an imposed code loses the distinctions it merges. Being joined through couplings is not enough.
Theorem: a group's closure is the union of its members'; on the World a pool separates exactly what some member separates, and no more.

account_adds.en: That agreement can cost distinctions, and returns only from a form held outside or coined. 'None says whether a code supports or damages 生生.'

source_adds.en: Overlap in what matters and what is owed; trust and belonging; the claim that this, not compute, is scarcest. No law of the account says shared reality is what coordination runs on.

name.en: A thousand participants, a thousand Wamos

source.locator: The argument: Wamotopia, and what it claims to demonstrate; claim 110

sense.en: Everyone formed their own understanding of the 2022 festival, yet the narrative succeeded because its principles became the framework of collaboration. Semantic underdetermination is a feature of the coordination mechanism, not noise in it.

entries.quote: 一千个参与者有一千个瓦猫之夏，每个人对它都会产生自己的理解

reading.en: Weakly, and marked so: the laws asking for joint success ask for compatible moves, not one meaning, and several forms for one sense do no harm. So divergent readings are not in themselves a failure. The account does not state the positive claim that plurality helps; §9's own direction is toward one form. A reviser should test whether this should be not-carried. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): where every joint step projects onto a step of each part, the joint class lies over classes the parts' plans keep, and the plans are compatible, the zipped joint plan keeps both guards. Applications must establish projection and compatibility.
Theorem (any type): a code letting a sense hold several forms reads every held form back as its sense exactly where no two senses hold one form: synonyms do no harm and homonyms do.

account_adds.en: The edge: homonyms do harm. One word read as different senses, which is what a thousand Wamos may be, is the harmful case, not the harmless one.

source_adds.en: That plural reading was part of why it worked, as an observed property of one event.

name.en: A protocol, not an institution: the consensus as a licence

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol; claims 42–44, 111

sense.en: Wamo is a rule-set on which self-organization runs: a shared language letting independent nodes cooperate without a central controller. We govern the protocol, not people. The coordinating artefact is a text like a licence, propagated widely, so the consensus and not an organizing body is the infrastructure.

entries.quote: it is a consensus file, like a license, that we all follow, just like Creative Commons license

reading.en: A licence has the form of local authorization that composes: joint plans from a supported start ask that every pair of locally authorized moves be jointly allowed. The minimal model of a rule held through the members it limits has no controller, and 01's reading says consent and penalties are observationally alike until penalties are removed. The law sets what the licence must establish; compliance is left out. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process, periphery module): with faithful projections and valid local plans, two properties holding on the covered start, every pair of locally authorized moves jointly allowed, every admitted joint successor keeping both, the paired finite plan is valid.

Theorem (root; a family of models): one kind of institution, an entry rule on a shared stock passed through members who also keep it. Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation into one count, so the laws say nothing of them. Not a definition of an institution.

account_adds.en: What must hold for it to work, and 'a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule'.

source_adds.en: The design decision itself, and the claim that a text propagated is sufficient infrastructure, with its neutrality deliberately incomplete.

name.en: Latent coordination capacity is built before it is spent

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol; claim 45

sense.en: Events are manifestations running on the protocol. The protocol is the shared agreement that lets a connected network form before any concrete action is planned: by creating togetherness we create the capacity to act. The network is the product, what it does decided later.

entries.quote: By creating this togetherness and connection, we create the capacity to act

reading.en: Ignition needs a reserve already present, and formed conditions carried the next stretch in selected software histories. That is capacity prior to use, stated as specific conditions, not an interchangeable amount. Under premises, building shared capacity can be warranted without fixing one carrier. [AI reading]

says.en: Promises do not suffice: 'if the other eventually does, I eventually do' holds on both sides where neither ever happens. In the exchange witness ignition needs a reserve already present: one circular dependence can be maintenance running or a wait no one can begin.

Assessment (selected histories, no theorem, not a universal law): in LibreOffice and Narwhal, inherited code, work, coordination and interim support carried activity before a lasting organization formed, as specific conditions, not interchangeable amounts.

Conditional (the condition for scope, C for order, neither asserted, with J1–J4): under these premises it can warrant building shared capacity without fixing one carrier; overbuilding that depletes the living basis is its counterexample.

account_adds.en: The failure case: a loop of mutual promise that never starts, and overbuilding as a counterexample.

source_adds.en: That togetherness in itself is this capacity. The account's capacity is specific conditions; togetherness is not tested as one.

name.en: The Abundance Loop, seeded by an unconditional gift

source.locator: The argument: The counter-logic; The unit of instantiation; claims 31, 57

sense.en: Value circulates instead of being captured: the more you give to the protocol, the more it supports you. The loop is seeded by an unconditional gift (无用之礼, a sticker, a candy, a sincere hug), and exchange must nourish rather than extract.

entries.quote: the more you give to the protocol, the more the protocol supports you

reading.en: The seed has an exact law: restoring needs a formation sparing all it waits on, without which total withholding stays; mutual promises alone cannot start a loop with no source. That is sharp structural agreement with 无用之礼. The return is scoped: whether giving rises depends on what it brings back, and assortment; giving alone is not repaid by law. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): a set giving at the start, each member waiting on at most its tolerance outside it, keeps giving. Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.

Theorem (a pair's run; offspring a supplied reading): where β ≤ γ, in every cohort listed as pairs whose places not of a kind withhold, the kind does not rise; under complete assortment answering is weakly favoured exactly where γ ≤ β.
With a source giving whatever it waits on, all give from step 3 from every start, in a ring of three. It does not show how waiting forms, or that cooperation is good.

account_adds.en: Why a gift and not a promise, and that a law of giving must change, not only a state. The README's own critique, reciprocity asserted without mechanism, stands against the source.

source_adds.en: That the protocol returns support to givers, and nourishment against extraction as a practical test. No mechanism of return is given in the source, or stated of any protocol in the account.

name.en: The Prime Directive: generate positive externality

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol; claims 46, 88

sense.en: One imperative: build in ways good for more than yourself; act so your winning benefits the whole. It is also a licence: as long as you generate no negative externalities you are free. Ren doubts the term and suggests positive sum.

entries.quote: As long as you are not generating negative externalities—and ideally, are creating positive ones—you are free

reading.en: The freedom condition has an exact form on the World: a part widening its own options widens the whole exactly while its net draw stays within every outside formation's margin, else mixed. But the source commands. The account proves a fact about admission and ranks only under two unasserted premises, the continuation condition for scope and C for order, warrant open. 'External' here is relative to an accounting's scope. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region, and is mixed exactly when it goes beyond for one. It predicts no behaviour.
Any type, a finite listing: one course widens another exactly when every positive weighting weighs it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways. That the wider is better is C's, not a law's.

account_adds.en: The hard case the directive hides: gains here and losses there are mixed and unranked, a measure for mixed parts is open, and J1–J4 are needed for choice.

source_adds.en: The obligation, and the practical licence. The README notes the directive has no check beyond dialogue; the margin law is a check the source lacks, for conserved amounts only.

name.en: Every action leaves the system richer and more alive

source.locator: Claims 31, 48

sense.en: Under Wamo, the product is positive externality: every action leaves the system richer, more connected and more alive than before; the ethos is to leave things more alive, more connected, more possible than you found them.

entries.quote: Every action leaves the system richer, more connected, and more alive than it was before.

reading.en: Universal in the source; the account gives where it can hold. In a finite balanced world no course keeps widening by name, though a witness keeps widening within kinds. Along a course of one fixed process the possible does not keep widening. Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance, so 'every action' would have to narrow nothing, and many actions are mixed. [AI reading]

says.en: World: a list holds every condition, balance, nothing from nothing, requirements within the list: a finite balanced world has no course that keeps widening by name; on a witness meeting the same premises the levels keep widening within kinds.

Theorem (any process; witnesses): along a course of a process nothing is added to the whole possible under it; where the possible under Q keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of moves of Q throughout.

account_adds.en: Direction kept apart from continuing growth at each step; 'an expansion producing ever more novelty' is not 生生. Ranking any of it needs C for order and the condition for scope, neither asserted.

source_adds.en: The aspiration as a description of how life under the protocol goes, with no measure proposed.

name.en: Two gods, and Wamo as the dominant attractor

source.locator: Claims 18, 39, 41; Open questions: Dominant attractor

sense.en: History is a tension between two attractors, a metaphor of two gods: Moloch, God of Decay, and Wamo, God of Life. The aim is to make coordination more rewarding than zero-sum competition and Wamo the dominant civilizational attractor, without eliminating competition.

entries.quote: the dominant civilizational attractor

reading.en: A counter-rule read from its own share locks as the rule it replaced did, and only reading beyond its share leaves; 07 reads the imperial examination so. A dominant Wamo is thus a capture candidate by the account's own law, as the README suspects. And no dynamic is God of anything: the laws say none of it supports or damages 生生. The glossary's meta-attractor is closed capture only. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects, every rule read favouring its carriers, locks by the step after its second reading step, as the rule it replaced did; only a change of law, such as reading what lies beyond its share, leaves the lock for long.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Openness is a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once.

Theorem (any type): where the rule is read against the share, selection under favouring rules does not lower it, and the rules favour at every step, a later reading's rule is not above an earlier one's: the rise the lock rests on does not form.

account_adds.en: What a counter-attractor would have to be to avoid its own law: a rule reading beyond its share, or read against it. 'A real loss need not form a meta-attractor', so the binary is not forced from the loss side either.

source_adds.en: The metaphor of life against decay, flagged as metaphor by the source, and the strategic goal of dominance. Ren's own 2026 'keep the possibility space open' and hierarchy notes move away from it in the source too.

name.en: If I thrive, the network thrives

source.locator: The argument: The counter-logic; claim 31

sense.en: Wamo is defined as the logic in which self-interest and collective interest are aligned: if I thrive the network thrives, and if the network thrives I thrive more.

entries.quote: If I thrive, the network thrives. If the network thrives, I thrive more.

reading.en: The account starts from actual relations, not a fixed common utility, and holds both: positive-sum structure and real conflict, both theorems. Position cannot rise for all. Mutual dependence is not mutual benefit. So alignment of interests is a case, where a part's draw stays within others' margins, not a logic one can adopt everywhere. [AI reading]

says.en: Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum, not rivalry, and both are theorems: a difference parts make only together is made by no part alone; positions' rises total their falls, so no change raises every part's position. Positional goods stay zero-sum, conserved stocks rivalrous (a reading).
'Mutual dependence is not mutual benefit, and its pace bounds what can arrive.' A flow is mutually dependent exactly where every reach closure is the whole.

account_adds.en: That the collective has no interest of its own here: 'a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real'.

source_adds.en: The claim that a protocol can make this alignment hold among its adopters.

name.en: Radical Interconnection: a node, as systemic physics

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol; claims 48, 75

sense.en: The compass pillar rejects the illusion of separation on systemic, not spiritual, grounds: in Moloch's world you are an island, here a node. Ubuntu ('I am because we are') survives in it unnamed. It asks a shift from extraction to contribution.

entries.quote: This is not just spiritual; it is systemic physics

reading.en: One relational unfolding is the nearest: taker and drawn-on as two roles of one relatum, argued as a thesis, not physics. That actual people lie within one another's closures is empirical in the account. That one's effects are one's own is its open crux, and even then no duty follows. No tradition's Ubuntu is spoken for here. [AI reading]

says.en: §4.7, as ONE-PAGE states it [AI reading], argued, not proved: if your act changes a river a village drinks from, is what becomes of the village part of your own continuation? Drawing the self so wide may only redefine it. The condition and C stay premises either way.
Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1–T8): there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it. ONE-PAGE: it forbids explanations, not observations.
Theorem (World, no premise for the closures): sharing throughout, mutual dependence and mutual feeding are three distinct ways closures can be the whole; neither converse holds.

account_adds.en: Three separate senses of connectedness, and that none yields concern for others without the step of invariance or the path of §4.6.

source_adds.en: The ethical shift it asks of adopters, and 'physics' as the ground. The account does not call relationality physics or a ground of obligation.

name.en: Survival, not morality, is the reason to choose it

source.locator: The argument: The counter-logic; claim 22

sense.en: Why should an individual choose Wamo when the system rewards accumulation? Not morality or willpower but survival: a civilization building AI to win its vital games loses to it. Shifting the game is the only viable strategy; survival is the ultimate incentive alignment.

entries.quote: Survival is the ultimate incentive alignment.

reading.en: Self-concern, a premise weaker than C, ranks a coupled ending below a course that continues: the source's move, with no morality. Its scope is exact: an independent copy reverses it, and it does not select one member's restraint where the rest outruns the renewal, which is the free-rider gap the README names. Survival aligns the order over wholes, not the member's act. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: every order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts (balance, gated renewal, uptake above replenishment) below one agreeing until then and adding to that continuation, with no C; where the other keeps an independent copy, some such order reverses.

With need one, in two such flows every score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores them alike however the member's act differs: no weight on such a reading selects the member's restraint.

account_adds.en: That the argument reaches only what returns to the self: losses returning to no one need the continuation condition, and any ranking beyond this case needs C.

source_adds.en: 'The only viable strategy', and the empirical premise that AI in vital games ends us. The account claims neither, and a law of the dynamics gives no such necessity.

name.en: Humanity already knows what a good civilization is

source.locator: The argument: Technology has no direction; claim 6

sense.en: The diagnosis is not ignorance. Humanity already knows what a good civilization looks like (unity, trust, shared flourishing); the problem is the System: wisdom of gods, games of parasites, love and unity software on rivalrous hardware.

entries.quote: Love and Unity software on Rivalrous hardware

reading.en: The source asserts unconditionally what the account gives only under premises. No law says cooperation is good; C and the continuation condition are unasserted, warrant open; and T5's valuers are a live test whose frozen rules partly failed, with human valuers untested. The account has no premise that the good is already known, and keeps warrant, recognition, motivation and compliance apart where the source runs them together. [AI reading]

says.en: Any evaluation is not shown: no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. That is asked under the continuation condition for scope and C for order.
A statement reading no order that entails C at a datum fails there for every order (ReadsNoOrder.not_entails), immediate since 'better' is free.

T5: VD1 (96 AI-persona valuers) every frozen rule failed; VD2 had mixed verdicts. Human valuers untested. Argued T8: 生生 for life, under the two premises; no verdict binding every possible mind is claimed.

account_adds.en: A bound on where disagreement among those counting everything positively can fall: only on mixed comparisons, and hard cases are mixed.

source_adds.en: The asserted content of the good, and hardware against software as the locus of failure.

name.en: A North Star for human flourishing

source.locator: Claims 33, 35

sense.en: The protocol's neutrality is deliberately incomplete: it needs a vision for all, human flourishing rather than concentrated power, and the automated layer is to be the foundation of a humanity-oriented life and freedom.

entries.quote: human flourishing instead of concentrated power

reading.en: Whose flourishing differs. T8's 生生 is life in the whole, its way offered for life, with every continuation's losses counted, of whatever substrate, and not human flourishing. Under the condition the fishers' catch and the mussel bed both count. The source's stated target is human; its 'for all' is read here as all humans, which a reviser should check against LONG's 'for all' of the commons. [AI reading]

says.en: T8: for life, the way is 生生, life in the whole and its continuing generation [AI reading, D1], compared by widening, counted for everything (scope: the continuation condition) and ranked under C. 'For life' says whose way it is, not whose losses count. Argued, neither premise asserted.

account_adds.en: Scope beyond the human, and the absence of any verdict binding every possible mind.

source_adds.en: A human-centred target, offered as the anti-capture device in a protocol.

name.en: Efficiency, markets and clicks do not say what should become

source.locator: Claim 14

sense.en: Technology solves for efficiency and does not generate meaning; markets route resources and do not produce wisdom; algorithms optimize clicks and cannot tell us what a civilization should become.

entries.quote: Algorithms optimize clicks; they cannot tell us what a civilization should become.

reading.en: In form, a statement reading only the dynamics cannot fix significance or order, and 05 says no market law ranks arrangements. But the account's limit is general: it binds human descriptions as much as algorithms, so it gives no place where meaning and wisdom do come from, which the source implies people have. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): a statement reading only the dynamics that entails the continuation condition holds of no dynamics, where there is a standpoint and a formation. So whose losses count does not come from any description of the dynamics, however complete.
A market is joint activity whose selection runs through payments; 'no universal phase threshold is claimed, and no market law ranks arrangements.'

account_adds.en: An exact statement of the limit, and that it does not spare the critic.

source_adds.en: Meaning and wisdom as what is missing, and humans or culture as their source.

name.en: Coordination by signal, steered by many local consensuses

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol (Living Signal); claim 50

sense.en: Moloch coordinates by price or command; Wamo by Signal: visible intentions, locations and experiments on a shared open map, choosing meaning over pure incentives. With no central allocation of attention, the emergent pattern from many local consensuses can guide us toward better futures.

entries.quote: the emergent pattern from many local consensuses can guide us, collectively, toward better futures

reading.en: Legibility has the form of adding couplings: a selection through payments reaches what couples into payments, a pool reaches what some member reads. But coupling bounds response and fixes nothing within the bound, a pool recruiting through itself couples into a loss only as its course without the loss would, and 'guide toward better' needs C. The hopeful sentence is what the account's No guarantee declines. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): what a pool decides by its acts is a selection through its pooled coupling. Coupling bounds response and does not fix it: the law exchanging nothing reads through every coupling too.

Theorem (World; hypotheses): a pool recruiting through itself comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; a reader admitted from outside couples it apart. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.

Theorem (near-definitional): where every member from member k on acts alike whatever its coupling, every selection through the acts is one through the couplings of the members before k, however many follow.

account_adds.en: A failure mode for signal: a visible cascade carries no more than its first readers, so a map with many entries need not read more.

source_adds.en: The Social Layer as a tool, and whether signal out-coordinates price at all, which neither states.

name.en: Gatekeeping is how scarcity is manufactured

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol (Permissionless Agency); claim 49

sense.en: Abundance emerges when people need no permission to do good. Moloch's gatekeepers manufacture scarcity, so Wamo destroys gatekeepers. Prefer many incomplete, courageous attempts to one perfect solution: do not complain that something is missing, create it.

entries.quote: Abundance emerges when people do not have to ask for permission to do good

reading.en: In 05 §12's model an entry rule is the door and the stock's keeper: open entry ends the level exactly where its take exceeds renewal, while a rule in its band keeps it, and in other cases the rule ends what open entry would keep. So a gate is neither scarcity's maker nor its cure in general. The attempts half agrees: selection does not create an absent practice. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root; a family of models): two tests, the steady state's and open entry's: the second's level goes on exactly where f·s ≤ g, otherwise ending; all four combinations occur. Reading: neither the rule's being present nor its being held decides. No actual institution is shown to meet the hypotheses.

Theorem (periphery: the market model): a share of none stays none, a witness: selection does not create an absent practice. The reading adds that a lost capacity needs actual entry, which the share law lacks.

account_adds.en: The other side, which the source would resist: a door can keep what open entry ends, and open-access overdraw is Gordon and Hardin's.

source_adds.en: The causal claim about actual gatekeepers, and permissionless creation as the engine.

name.en: Creation scatters, coordination freezes: the dynamic edge

source.locator: The argument: From a logic to a protocol (Living Signal); claim 50

sense.en: A control problem stated by the theory: tilt only into raw creation and everything scatters; cling only to coordination and everything freezes. Wamo lives on the dynamic edge between the two.

entries.quote: Tilt only into raw creation and everything scatters; cling only to coordination and everything freezes.

reading.en: The freezing half has a law: moves of one fixed process do not keep the possible widening, so a held rule must change without end, and that is not sufficient. A pace law bounds how fast a rule may change. I found no law that too much creation scatters, and none locating an edge. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening; the possible with a part held keeps widening only where the part changes without end, and endless change does not suffice.

Theorem (any type): a rule that never reads is unreached; a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step. Given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of held-rule courses with at most N states exactly when L ≥ 2N − 1.

account_adds.en: Exact sense of freezing, and its limit: nothing says which changes keep it widening.

source_adds.en: The scattering half, and the edge as the place to live.

name.en: Hold the old system while the new is built beneath it

source.locator: The argument: The holding strategy; Strategy: obsolescence; claims 33, 40, 99

sense.en: Neither stop nor accelerate: hold the market stable a decade or two while a fully automated layer is built underneath. Build alongside the old rather than bringing it down. Against entrenched power, no confrontation: viable alternatives that make it lose relevance, and awareness at the meta-layer.

entries.quote: We can build a new system alongside the old before it collapses, instead of taking it down and fall into chaos

reading.en: The form of a funded transition is on a market model and a succession carrier: support carries a state into protection, and cannot be paid with the improvement it brings. That is the holding strategy's structural need. 05 reads that a condition indispensable to one way of organizing is not thereby basic. Awareness at the meta-layer has the form of reading beyond the share. [AI reading]

says.en: Law for any process; market instance periphery, under named hypotheses: a support cover carries each positive state through a finite correction into protection; sufficient hypotheses, not least; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.
Theorem (periphery): selection must fund actual succession; a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration in a witness.

Reading [AI reading, D65; any ranking is C's, under the two premises of 07]: capture and drain give institutions no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow; a condition indispensable to one way of organization is not thereby basic.

account_adds.en: The finance of the transition and when it is impossible: a window, and a seed too small under a finite support.

source_adds.en: The number (a decade or two), the automated layer, and the stance against both collapse and acceleration. The market model is not the source's market.

name.en: Keep AI out of the human game of competition

source.locator: The argument: The holding strategy; claims 33, 98

sense.en: Do not use AI for competition; use it for the benefit of all. The minimal global rule, offered as a compromise and forcefully executed: stop using AI to compete with others, use it only for commons.

entries.quote: stop using AI compete with others, only use them for commons, for the purpose of all, as a first principle

reading.en: The live direction reads differently: align AI with actual living, under premises, keeping challenge and revision effective. It sets no rule on AI's entering human games. 'AI must not join human games' stands in theories/zhishan-intelligence-must-be-good/README.md (人工智能不应加入人与人的博弈), an earlier folder, and the transcripts. 07's reading that a fixed rule does not keep the possible widening is about openness, not this rule's merit. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The rule, its rule-first framing, and who would force it, which the README flags as unanswered. Stands in this folder, the zhishan folder, and sources/02-wamotopia transcripts.

searched: compet, rival, join, game, winner, arms race in 05, 07, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION, the overview, ALIGNMENT.md

name.en: All but the winner gain from AI not playing, so the rule is rational

source.locator: The argument: The holding strategy; claim 97

sense.en: In a winner-takes-all game everyone but the final winner is better off if AI does not play, and even the winner ends up subordinated; so the set of parties benefiting is empty and a global consensus is rationally available.

entries.quote: 除了最后的胜利者，其他人的利益其实都是偏向不与ai博弈的

reading.en: The account's law separates what all would gain from what each would do: at a mutual best response each optimizer takes its whole capacity wherever something stands, so restraint is no mutual best response, and among position-rankers keeping is never a best response. So rational availability is exactly what those models deny, within their hypotheses. Models of actual races are not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: At a mutual best response each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands, so restraint is no mutual best response; existence of a mutual best response not shown in general; balance at the step; each optimizer's family and beyond set apart.

With several drawers in turn, no floor and a positive need, every perfect profile leaves nothing before the horizon where the coupling a step is below the need; where it exceeds it, under named conditions on what stands next, the need is kept. Drawing at once, where no portion reaches the need, draining is perfect at every coupling.

account_adds.en: A route that keeps a need on those models: a coupling reaching it, so what each ranks changes, rather than an appeal to a shared interest; and even that fails for drawers acting at once under the named condition.

source_adds.en: An argument about actual parties' interests over whole outcomes, which those models do not read. 'Better off' is the source's comparison, over outcomes as each party would value them.

name.en: The threshold decade, the narrow window

source.locator: Claim 16

sense.en: We are inside a threshold decade: the architectures built now, technical, legal, economic and cultural, decide whether there is a humane future. We do not have centuries.

entries.quote: We do not have centuries.

reading.en: A window has an exact form in the counts model: a reading turns the course only while the late reading still favours the others at the next share, after which every reading keeps the lock; at most one step lies between. The account reads it with Collingridge. It closes on the share's course, not on a date. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): where the loss grows and lo' ≤ hi, a reading, the next step reading too, turns the course for good exactly where the late reading still favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock. Drawn one at a time, locks are left by drift.
Every capture law here is a two-kind count model, its locks stated without noise; over long horizons the window is not the only exit. None shown to hold of an actual collective.

account_adds.en: That the window is not final under drift, which softens the source's urgency, and that a reader cannot see from loss size where it closes.

source_adds.en: The date: this decade for this civilization. Stated without argument in the source, and not in the account.

name.en: The trap is made by believing in it

source.locator: The argument: The logic being amplified; claims 92, 93, 94

sense.en: Believing that others will compete and that not playing means losing itself creates the trap and reality. Belief in Moloch's inevitability works as a cult dynamic, a form of extremism; political realism and accelerationism are self-fulfilling gods.

entries.quote: this kind of thinking itself creates the trap and reality

reading.en: 05 has it almost in words: 'Others will deceive me, so I deceive first' is withholding with memory, which absorbs. A public prediction read by the response is an input to what it predicts. But the account's lesson differs: from total withholding only a law change restores, so seeing through the belief is not itself the exit; a source that gives must exist. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D48]: 'Others will deceive me, so I deceive first' is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. Mutual promises alone cannot start a loop with no source.

Theorem (any type; near-definitional, with one general law): a published prediction read by the response is right exactly where the response to it is itself; where the response moves every value none is right. Reading: Merton 1948's self-fulfilling and self-defeating prophecy.

account_adds.en: That a belief being self-fulfilling does not make it false, and that changing it alone does not restore giving.

source_adds.en: The diagnosis of actual ideologies as cult dynamics, and the moral charge of extremism.

name.en: Flexible substrates get memetically captured

source.locator: The argument: The objections on record; Open questions (Social Layer)

sense.en: Em's objection: a blockchain can encode any coordination pattern and yet re-enacts Wall Street, because what you do with a capability is fixed by interaction patterns already installed, changed only over years. A permissionless protocol is the kind of thing that gets colonized. Ren answers with a North Star; the README calls that thin.

entries.quote: If she is right, then a permissionless protocol is exactly the kind of thing that gets colonized by the dominant logic

reading.en: Two mechanisms carry the form. A pool recruiting through itself reads only as its course would; and a shared interface's controller changes others' admission through operation. 'Patterns of capture pass as patterns of care do.' A North Star read from the share would absorb like any counter-rule. How pools resist capture is explicitly open. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; recruitment and same members at the start as hypotheses): the pool comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; a reader admitted at a scheduled step couples it apart, in a witness.
Open: how pools form, last and resist capture beyond recruitment through their own coupling; resisting a capture that hides a loss needs a member admitted by what the pool does not yet read.
Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

account_adds.en: What the anti-capture device must be: a reader from outside the share, not a stated vision.

source_adds.en: The installed-pattern mechanism, its timescale of years, and the Social Layer as the single dependency in a decentralization story.

name.en: Moloch coordinates better, and is itself self-organized

source.locator: The argument: The objections on record; Open questions

sense.en: Kabir Veitas: clocks and events are coordination; Moloch wins because it is better coordinated, and that coordination is self-organized from interactions. So we must use its dynamics to break it. The README: how signal beats clock-and-command is not answered anywhere, the theory's largest gap.

entries.quote: that's why Moloch is winning, because they're much better coordinated in doing stuff

reading.en: The capture laws need no organizer, so the self-organized half fits them, but no law compares the coordinating power of one mechanism against another, and 05 §10 reads payments only as selection. The gap stands in the account too: nothing says when a signal-based pool outdoes a price-based one. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The objection, and the comparison it demands. Stands in this folder and the NuNet transcript in sources/02-wamotopia.

searched: price, command, clock, efficient, self-organiz in 05 and COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION

name.en: Instrumental use of their means, believing we are not them

source.locator: Claim 37; The objections on record

sense.en: Under urgency some approaches can be taken instrumentally, but we must believe deep down that we are not them: no exploitation, no new hierarchy, no will to power. The README: an answer to the ethics of the question, not its mechanics.

entries.quote: we can take some approaches instrumentally, but we also need to believe deep down that we are not them

reading.en: The account gives inner conviction no standing as a brake: the rule locks if read from its share, whatever those it selects believe of themselves, and what selects the capacity to shape is what comes back to the shapers. Help lowering the cost of shaping raises that selection. So the guard must be in what is read and what returns. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): at a step the rule favours the shapers exactly where c ≤ s, whatever comes to every member alike; a smaller cost gives a rule not lower. With nothing coming back and a cost, the shapers' share falls at every step. A two-kind count model.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read from its share locks as the rule it replaced did, as the imperial examination is read: designed to dilute hereditary capture, it later became a proxy trap of its own.

account_adds.en: A concrete design rule: rule-making that brings nothing back to its makers alone, at a cost, loses share.

source_adds.en: The commitment as such. Whether belief changes what readers read is not modelled, so this is a divergence of emphasis and not a refutation.

name.en: Hierarchy is not intrinsically bad

source.locator: The argument: The counter-logic; claim 105

sense.en: Ren's 2026 correction: hierarchy can be good or bad, status can be channelled, some centralized systems worked better than decentralized ones. Design systems that work and claim no absolute. No Wamo document reflects it.

entries.quote: hierarchy can be good or bad, status can be channelled properly, it is to design systems that work, but not go into extremes to claim what is absolute

reading.en: The account refuses the binary in its own terms: capture laws give institutions no prior duty to contract nor licence to grow, and selected control is not thereby capture. It says nothing of hierarchy as such, status or history's examples. 'Better' here would be read by what compares; the source's 'works' leaves that unnamed. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; any ranking is C's, under the two premises of 07]: whether a development calls for expanding, maintaining, reorganizing or contracting is asked of the whole continuation it forms.

Dossier: selected control is not thereby capture. What the rule reads is fixed by a premise on its readers, not by the shaping, so the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.

account_adds.en: A question to replace the binary: who decides admission, comparison and correction next round.

source_adds.en: Hierarchy, status and peace as historical and anthropological claims. The account has a hierarchy only as families of flows, another reference.

name.en: Narratives construct reality; reality as collective dream

source.locator: Claims 81, 82, 83, 118; In Ren's own words 34, 39, 40

sense.en: The 2023 layer: narratives anchor reality and consume agency; values are emotional symbols, and intersubjective reality emerges from shared ideals. Everything is constructed by its environment and shapes you in turn. The end game is to understand reality construction, not in a post-modern way, so as to construct our world better.

entries.quote: Reality is but a manifestation / Of our collective dreams.

reading.en: Reciprocity of self and environment agrees with the reading loop: what a formation does is part of what goes on, and consequences select the organization that learns. But the poem's line diverges: in closed capture a loss passes every bound unread, so what goes on is not what the shared reading holds. A poem, and the source later says 'not post-modern', so this is held loosely. [AI reading]

says.en: A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on. Knowing is a relation, not a mirror beside it.
From a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked: the loss is not read and goes on growing, under the theorem's hypotheses.

account_adds.en: A loss unread is still a loss in the model: 'a selection can succeed while what it cannot read is lost'. And a formed code merges distinctions rather than making a world.

source_adds.en: Personas and masks consuming agency, values as emotional symbols, and construction as the aim.

name.en: History rewards whoever coordinates

source.locator: The argument: The fork; claim 30

sense.en: Coordination is the load-bearing variable of history: those who effectively coordinate people achieve great things and become the foundation of higher complexity.

entries.quote: out of history is always the one that effectively coordinate people

reading.en: Selection among groups has an exact condition: keeping is favoured among groups only where the spread among groups outweighs what selection within removes. That is one route by which coordinated groups gain, for equal groups and additive returns. The account also reads no rank rising with complexity. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): Hamilton's rule. For groups of equal size and additive returns, selection within goes against keeping; among groups it goes for keeping exactly where a stated condition on spreads holds.

account_adds.en: The condition, and its other edge: 'not by rank rising with complexity' (07, a reading).

source_adds.en: The historical generalization, and coordination as what makes higher complexity. Not stated.

name.en: Dali 2022 as a feasibility proof, money and organizer removed

source.locator: The argument: Wamotopia, and what it claims to demonstrate; claims 76, 106–109, 113

sense.en: When lockdown dissolved the main venue and the team disbanded and returned its funding, the festival still happened: dozens of camps, thousands of co-builders. Narrative produces consensus, consensus leads to action; so large-scale coordination driven by neither capital nor authority is feasible. Each café became a Schelling point.

entries.quote: 通过叙事在群体之间产生共识，并导向行动，大规模去中心化的协调是可以产生的

reading.en: The account takes up no such event; no test has human participants, no institution is on the spine, and 05 lists Wamo as correspondence not established. It would ask questions of Dali: what reserve was already present (cafés, a gathered milieu, a shared prior name), since ignition needs one; what broke the symmetry; and whether one uncontrolled event is evidence of the mechanism. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The folder's only field evidence, and the three-step mechanism. Stands in this folder and sources/02-wamotopia; no recap of 2026 exists in the corpus.

name.en: Presence is what technology leaves to humans

source.locator: The argument: Wamotopia, and what it claims to demonstrate; claims 62, 72

sense.en: If technology absorbs everything transmissible, what is left is body warmth, gaze and presence: shared experience no algorithm replicates if you were not there. Ren's more careful version: online spreads reasoning, but certain magics happen only offline, and a culture needs people together.

entries.quote: there are certain magics that only happens offline

reading.en: The account's 'embodied' means a relatum standing at a positive level exactly while active: the same word, another reference. Nothing live says that presence carries what transmission cannot, or that a culture needs bodies together. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole claim, and with it the argument for a place rather than a network. Stands in this folder and sources/02-wamotopia.

name.en: Automated labour cuts people off from the market's route

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claim 25

sense.en: When all labour is automated, humans who depend on markets to route resources to them lose the route, and nothing is prepared to prevent the massive suffering; the states pursuing this may lack the rationality they assume.

entries.quote: When all labour is automated, the humans who depend on markets to route resources to them lose the route

reading.en: The market section keeps what further exchange and life depend on as a general question, with a model and a hypothetical provider case, but says nothing of labour, wages or automation. A real gap for a theory that reads markets as selection through payments: those no payment couples to are the case it should reach. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The mechanism and prediction. Stands in this folder; the 2026 Fork is also in theories/the-fork-and-cooperative-infrastructure/.

name.en: AI is taking our truth away

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claim 26

sense.en: We can no longer tell what comes from AI and what from us, nor read the intentionality behind narratives and media, which attacks shared reality, the substrate the rest of the theory depends on.

entries.quote: And AI is "taking our truth away"

reading.en: Nearest forms: copied witnesses add nothing, and reviewers count by independent causes, not names, which would bear on many AI voices with one cause. Those are laws of certificates, and the account does not state this claim about public truth or attribution, and I would not read it in. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The claim. Stands in this folder and the festival talk in sources/02-wamotopia.
